title: Hybrid-precision sweep harness for latency/quality regression detection
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a repeatable, scalable harness that runs exhaustive hybrid-precision sweeps (FP16 / INT8 / INT4 and mixed-block patterns) across representative workloads and detects regressions in throughput (tokens/sec) and tail latency (p95) while correlating quality delta per prompt set.
motivation: Current quantization sweeps focus on single-dimension benchmarks (throughput or quality). Teams need a platform-grade harness to evaluate mixed-precision configurations and runtime scheduling impacts on multi-tenant workloads so we can offer safe quantization recommendations in Redwood Optimize and enforce CI regressions for Dedicated/Private customers.
proposed_changes: 1) Extend existing loadbench runner to accept precision matrices and mixed-block directives. 2) Add layered metrics: tokens/sec aggregate, tokens/sec per-model, p95 token latency, quant-error per prompt (BLEU/ROUGE/semantic-similarity), and A/B diff heatmap. 3) Implement automated regression detector with historical baseline and bootstrap confidence intervals. 4) Persist profiles to quant-profile store and surface in Console.
benchmark_matrix: Axes: model family (LlamaX-13B, RedGem-7B), sequence length distribution (chat-short, chat-medium, completion-long), batch sizes (1..32), precision pattern (FP16, INT8, INT4, MIXED block-level), KV cache hit ratios (0%, 25%, 75%). Output: tokens/sec, p95 latency, QoE delta for prompt suites.
data_sets: Use: 1) core-chat-1k (short dialog turns, 1k examples), 2) long-complete-500 (500 long-context completions), 3) eval-robust-200 (edge cases). Mark dataset provenance and augmentation scripts in links.
metrics: Primary: tokens_per_sec (median and 95th-percentile across runs), p95_token_latency, quality_delta_semantic (embedding cosine), stern_score (new composite combining semantic+surface errors). Secondary: memory-use, GPU_util, ctx_switch_rate.
alerting_rules: Regression rule: if tokens_per_sec drops >7% relative to baseline with p<0.01 AND quality_delta_semantic worse by >1.5% then fail CI. Latency rule: p95_token_latency increase >20% triggers high-priority alert. Quality-only degradations >3% create advisory. Rules codified as SQL in metrics DB and as webhook to regression-sentry.
test_harness_design: Runner accepts JSON job spec listing precision matrix and scheduling hints. Each job executes N=5 warmup runs + M=10 measurement runs. Deterministic seeding for model RNG, capture generated tokens for quality checks. Support multi-VM distributed load via k6 style orchestrator and native runtime hooks for KV cache warm/cold cycles.
implementation_plan: Week1: extend runner to emit new metrics and accept precision matrices. Week2: implement mixed-block quant support in profile scheduler. Week3: add regression detector and integrate with CI. Week4: run full sweep for two model families, produce report and Console feature flag for suggestions.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Harness can run full matrix end-to-end without manual steps. 2) Regression detector flags injected synthetic regressions in unit tests. 3) Console shows profile recommendations with estimated cost delta. 4) Documentation and runbook exist and owners trained.
runbook: How to run: ./bench/run_sweep --spec specs/hybrid_precision.json --runs 10. Troubleshooting: inspect bench/logs/*.json for per-run tokens/sec/p95; check metrics DB for sample variance. Contacts: Arjun Patel (assignee), Maya Chen (creator), ML Infra on-call.
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal runtime/opt teams only for two weeks. Beta: select Dedicated customers via feature flag. GA: include in Optimize recommendations once false-positive rate <1% and runbook validated.
risks_mitigation: Risk: noisy variance produces false positives. Mitigation: use bootstrap CI and minimum effect size. Risk: mixed-block paths may not be supported on all kernels. Mitigation: auto-fallback to nearest supported pattern and mark as 'approximate' in results.
notes: Prototype data shows INT8 mixed with FP16 in attention blocks yields 1.6x tokens/sec at <1% semantic drift on core-chat-1k. Need more validation across prompt styles.
